He places the second finished cup on the log with the others.
The man arranges four bamboo cups in a row on the wooden log.
He adjusts the position of the bamboo cups on the log.
The man picks up a large bamboo teapot and walks away.
He carries the bamboo teapot through the forest clearing.
The man walks towards a rustic wooden table in the forest.
He reaches the wooden table and starts placing items on it.
The man places the bamboo teapot on the mossy wooden table.
He carefully arranges the bamboo cups next to the teapot.
The man finishes setting the table and steps away.

The man stands up with the knife and looks around the forest.

The man gathers the long, cut leaves into his hand.

The man adds more cut leaves to the bundle he is carrying.
He finishes cutting the long leaves and prepares to walk back.
The man walks through the thick brush carrying all the leaves.
He uses the knife to clear some vines as he walks.
The man pushes through the dense forest vegetation.
He is shown plucking more broad green leaves from a plant.
The man adds the broad leaves to his large bundle.
He holds the variety of gathered leaves in both hands.
The man turns and begins walking back towards the camp.
